svg.title: CTKG full architecture — 11-stage pipeline
svg.desc: Complete end-to-end pipeline of the Clinical Trials Knowledge Graph system, from user question through entity extraction, KG confirmation, analysis selection, Cypher execution, GraphRAG context assembly, Ollama answer generation, and Streamlit rendering.
